== Course of events ==

After the Tin Woodman felled a tree to bridge a second, wider ditch and the Lion agreed to carry each companion across an earlier, deep ditch on his back, fending off two pursuing Kalidahs before the Tin Woodman chopped away the fallen tree and sent the beasts crashing to their deaths below, a Stork agreed to rescue the Scarecrow. The Stork lifted the Scarecrow by the arms and carried him back to the group, returning him safely to his companions.

With the Scarecrow restored to the party, the group pressed onward toward a field of poppies. The Lion ran ahead but collapsed asleep just short of its edge, and the poppies' scent soon overpowered Dorothy, Toto, and the Lion as well, while the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman remained unaffected.
